purpose: Controlled identical-input comparison of the current One-Box pipeline (Path A) and direct Refero research handoff (Path B).

paths.label: Direct Refero MCP research workflow
paths.variable: direct Refero research and synthesis handoff

constants: copy facts, imagery policy, viewport checks, and quality gates

liveExecution.reason: The harness never authenticates, reads credentials, invokes Refero, invokes OpenRouter, or spends money. A separately approved live runner must record provenance before this harness will present or unblind results.

humanGate.rule: Two distinct named human evaluators must independently submit complete blind scores with evidence for every rubric area, each bound to the current presentation packet, before unblinding.

blinding.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, then remove non-letter and non-number characters before matching
blinding.presentationRule: Only requiredPresentationArtifacts are copied. Every source must be a regular non-symlink UTF-8 file. Full-set leak scanning completes before an atomic, immutable presentation publish. provenance.json stays coordinator-only.
blinding.neutralizationRule: Before submission, replace producer/provider/model/path identity, timestamps, latency, token use, and cost with neutral source IDs, freshness classes, and artifact-local evidence. Full values remain in provenance.json for post-score audit.
